purpose: external acceptance instrument for the ProgressDesk core delivery
criteria: Create Project validates the exact definition chain and both owner signoffs, and refuses a stale displayed draft revision
definition.revise creates a new revision bound to the exact prior revision and refuses a stale expected revision
definition.pending lists the VISP and FUSP revisions that still await an owner signoff
the planning board records topics, meetings, questions and answers as events and rebuilds them from the event log
planning formalization produces structured decisions, a plain-language summary and a draft artifact that keeps every attachment reference
the owner surface exposes pending decisions, milestone findings, acceptance evidence, recorded usage and the milestone signoff policy
the candidate package is imported from the assembled product, not from the factory
